environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode, and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in BLOCK mode with sensitivity level set to HIGH and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE applied to query string parameters. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLi rule group evaluates all query string parameters including 'department'.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL association
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with no additional permissions
